Trigger it for assembly analysis, live debugging, cipher identification, struct recovery, deobfuscation, or a quick strace. Python is declared because its readiness probes and its angr / Frida usage run on python3. Aimed at Linux user-space binaries; use the dedicated plugins for Windows or Android.

plugins.name: linker-fake-load-unwrapper
plugins.description: Unwrapping skill for Android AArch64 ELF files protected by a linker-style fake-load wrapper (one skill plus a principles reference, and a bundled linker_static_unwrap.py). It handles impossible high-address LOAD segments, translated entry points (e_entry minus the fake p_vaddr), XOR runtime decryptors, carved embedded ELF stages, shell-looking second stages, and custom mmap / mprotect loaders, providing static and dynamic workflows plus validation gates whose goal is the real runtime image. Trigger it with "linker hardening", "it unpacks but the SO won't load", or "generic linker unpack". Its bundled script runs on Python. For self-owned or authorized samples only.

plugins.description: Evidence-driven deobfuscation and plaintext recovery for Hikari-LLVM / OLLVM output (one skill plus seven references and a bundled hikari_*.py toolchain with tests). Trigger it with "Hikari deobfuscation" or "recover the strings from this OLLVM SO". Its own docs state "Python 3.10+; static rewriting needs capstone, the dynamic device path needs adb and read access to /proc/PID/mem", so Python >= 3.10 and the capstone package are declared — they are direct dependencies of the bundled tools, and without capstone static rewriting cannot run. Self-owned or authorized samples only.

plugins.name: seep-reverse-lab
plugins.description: Whole-package redistribution of angusdevgo/Seep-Reverse-Lab (GPL-3.0): an AI-native reverse-engineering workbench with 9 skills, 12 slash commands and 2 MCP servers. The softseep orchestrator routes plain-language requests; apkseep covers Android APK / AAB / DEX / SO end to end (client-side authorization review via CWE-602, micro-patching binary internals, dynamic Frida / RPC instrumentation, unpacking plus Java2C / VMP diffing, repackage and sign) with Recon asset profiling, four hard quality gates (G1-G4), anti-tamper and anti-hook playbooks and closed-loop delivery; it also ships a client license/authorization validation track, IDA Pro automation, and toolchain skills for jadx / radare2 / apktool / Frida. Commands: /triage /find-auth /gen-patch /hook /poc /report /kb /check /doctor /full /keygen /test. The `seep` MCP server exposes 23 tools over a 183+ technique knowledge base; `js-reverse` adds JS reverse and headless-browser capability. Prerequisites: Python >= 3.10 with the `mcp` package installed (`pip install "mcp>=1.20,<1.29"`) — without it that MCP fails to start; Node >= 18 for npx-running js-reverse-mcp; and the bundled toolchain (radare2 / JADX / Apktool / Playwright pieces) must be unpacked first via the upstream `setup/install.ps1` (Windows) or `setup/install.sh` (Linux / macOS). Its upstream Pi extension (lab-mode toggle, shorthand triggers, word-list replacement, Gemini BLOCK_NONE) is not loaded by CCode — those capabilities are provided by CCode-native mechanisms instead. Self-owned or authorized samples only.
